subject: Initial MAP canvas — starter GDoc + slides (proposal for Paxion)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Choi <sam.choi@paxion.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP canvas — starter GDoc + slides (proposal)

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the demo on Thursday. Per our conversation, I put together a lightweight MAP canvas and starter slide set to accelerate decisioning on your side. Links and short asks below:

- MAP starter doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAP_starter_doc (editable)
- Slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1MAP_starter_slides
- Attachments: MAP_Template_v1.gdoc (starter outline), MAP_Starter_Slides_v1.gslides

Suggested owners (from our side):
- Technical lead / integration owner: Marissa Cole
- Success / acceptance criteria owner: Jasmine Liu

Suggested 30-day evaluation timeline (high level):
1) Week 0 — Kickoff & access
2) Week 1 — Integration & baseline tests
3) Week 2 — Quality checks and acceptance criteria review
4) Week 3 — Scale tests + cost baseline
5) Week 4 — Final acceptance & exec review

Could you please review the doc and slides and add Paxion stakeholders who should receive the MAP? Also confirm whether a compressed 21-day timeline makes sense for you.

If this looks good I’ll lock owners and send calendar invites for a kickoff and a technical deep dive.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP_Template_v1.gdoc (outline), MAP_Starter_Slides_v1.gslides

From: Sam Choi <sam.choi@paxion.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@paxion.ai
Date: 2026-03-21T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP canvas — starter GDoc + slides (proposal)

Ben —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and clear outline. A few notes after a quick pass:

- Overall this is useful. We need an explicit acceptance metric for hallucination reduction for our triage assistant (can you add a target % and test set?
- Paxion prefers a 21-day window if we can compress the integration tasks — happy to scope steeper weekly goals if Redwood can provide a small test harness or sample dataset.
- Procurement asked that we surface SOC 2 evidence and an initial MSA/quote timeline in the MAP.

I’ve added myself and procurement@paxion.ai to the doc (comments on page 2). I’ll get our product lead (Lina Park) to add technical owners by tomorrow.

If you can sketch a 21-day milestone plan in the doc I’ll take it to our internal stakeholders this week.

Best,

Sam Choi
Head of Product, Paxion Health
sam.choi@paxion.ai

On 2026-03-21 09:03, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo on Thursday. Per our conversation, I put together a lightweight MAP canvas...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sam Choi <sam.choi@paxion.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP canvas — starter GDoc + slides (proposal)

Looping in a few technical comments and a proposed compressed timeline. Sam, thanks for calling out acceptance metrics — we’ll add a short validation plan and a baseline test harness.

Proposed compressed 21-day plan (draft):
- Day 0: Kickoff, creds, access to sample dataset
- Days 1–5: Integration + baseline inference tests (Marissa owner)
- Days 6–10: Quality evaluation vs. Paxion test set; add hallucination metric and threshold (Jasmine + Paxion PM)
- Days 11–15: Performance and cost runs (scale tests, Redwood infra)
- Days 16–20: Final acceptance run + exec summary prep
- Day 21: Acceptance review

I’ll seed the MAP doc with a 21-day version and a short validation appendix. Jasmine — can you own the acceptance criteria slide and add the SOC 2 evidence link we keep in our repository? (link below)

Internal reference: MAP authoring checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDWOOD_MAP_CHECKLIST

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP_Acceptance_Checklist.pdf (draft), integration_test_plan.md (stub)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sam Choi <sam.choi@paxion.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-23T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP canvas — starter GDoc + slides (proposal)

All — thanks. I updated the starter slides with an acceptance slide (added acceptance metrics and where we’ll run the baseline). I also uploaded a draft acceptance checklist (MAP_Acceptance_Checklist.pdf) to the doc.

I scheduled the kickoff + tech deep dive for Mar 25 10:00–11:30 PT — calendar invites sent. Ben/Marissa I assigned slide ownership: Marissa — integration runbook slides; Ben — exec summary; Jasmine — acceptance metrics + SOC2 evidence slide.

Sam — I’ll add a short test harness snippet to the doc by EOD so your team can start validations.

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
